summary: MaintCodeCategories is a maintenance screen for managing code categories in the HSPnet application. It supports viewing, adding, editing, deleting, and searching code categories. The UI is built with ASP.NET controls and AJAX, enabling modal popups and dynamic updates. The categories have fields for name, alternate locale, and description, with validation for mandatory fields. The screen allows navigation to related codes and handles error/warning messages with dedicated panels.
purpose: To provide administrative users the ability to maintain (add, edit, delete, search, view) code categories, which are used for organizing and managing subsequent codes within the system.

entities.name: CodeCategory
entities.description: Represents a category grouping for codes.

fields.name: CategoryAlt
fields.description: Alternate code category name for localization.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the code category.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Administrative user interacting with the maintenance screen.

workflows.name: View Code Categories
steps: Code categories are listed in a GridView.
User can search/filter categories by keyword.

workflows.name: Add Code Category
steps: Modal popup appears with DetailsView for entry.
Category added to database and grid refreshed.

workflows.name: Edit Code Category
steps: User clicks Edit for a category.
Modal popup appears with DetailsView for editing.

workflows.name: Delete Code Category
steps: User clicks Delete on a category.

workflows.name: Navigate to Codes
steps: User clicks To Codes for a category.
Redirects to MaintCode screen with InitialCategoryID in query string.

business_rules: Category and CategoryAlt are mandatory fields.
Description is optional but limited to 200 characters.
Only users in maintenance mode may access this screen.
Navigation to codes uses the selected category as a filter.
validations: MaxLength enforced for Category (50), CategoryAlt (50), Description (200).
conditions: Page loads only data relevant to current UserSession and keyword filtering input.
Modal popup appears conditionally for Add/Edit actions.
Panels for Error/Warning are only visible when triggered.
system_behavior: GridView displays categories and supports row command actions.
UpdatePanel used for partial page updates (AJAX).
ModalPopupExtender used for showing DetailsView dialog.
Error and warning messages are handled via dedicated panels.
Default button set to cmdRefreshView for quick searching.
dependencies: CodeCategories data binding and retrieval logic.
Grid utility methods for switching modes and showing details.
UserSession management for security and context.
AJAX Control Toolkit for modal popup and always-visible controls.
Resource files for UI texts and localization.
exceptions: Invalid UUID or missing category data disables actions.
Errors in add/edit/delete trigger error panel with message.
Missing mandatory fields trigger validations and error messages.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling code for database failures.
Resource key values not visible in source.
CodeCategory fields beyond Category, CategoryAlt, Description (e.g., ID) assumed from context but not defined in detail.
